literal_meaning: কোণে কোণে বা লুকানো জায়গায় খোঁজা
figurative_meaning_en: searching everywhere/thoroughly/in every nook and cranny/completely/all around
example_sentences_in_bangla: পুলিশ আঁতিপাঁতি খোঁজ করে চোরকে খুঁজছে।
আমি আঁতিপাঁতি করে চাবিটা খুঁজলাম কিন্তু পেলাম না।
example_sentences_in_english: The police are searching high and low for the thief.
I searched everywhere for the key but couldn't find it.
note: This idiom evokes the image of rummaging through hidden corners of a traditional Bengali household.
